Here is a line-by-line transcription of the historical parish marriage register page shown in `image_e1718e.png`.

The records are written in Latin, typical of 19th-century Irish Catholic parish registers, and predominantly signed by the parish priest, Lawrence Harnett ("Lau Harnett").

---

## Left Column

### Februarii 1854

* **8** Patritium Lyons et Catharinam Cussen viduam de pratis vulgo nominat. "Vullis" mat. junxi coram Patritio Shea et Hellena Reeves.
— *Lau. Harnett Parochus*
* **9** Johannem Fitzgerald et Brigidam Lea de Croom Mat. junxi, Presentibus Michaeli Geady et Catharina Ryan
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **25** Davidem Mulcahy et Mariam Hartigan de Ballyphilip Mat. junxit Revd. Johannes Mulcahy v. P. de Kilmallock coram Michaeli Mulcahy et Timotheo Hartigan
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **25** Petrum Flaherty et Margaritam Flaherty Mat. junxit Revd. Johannes Hayes dispensatime obtenta in impedimento dirimente Consanguinitatis in tertio et tertio Gradu Nec non in publicatione bannorum a Reverendissimo Episcopo Limericensi Johanne Ryan coram Honora Rahilly et Thoma Twomey
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **28** Patritium Hickey de Kissing et Margaritam Hogan de Chany(?) Grove Mat. junxi coram Adolpho Scanlan et Maria Hogan
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **25** Patritium Seely et Hellenam Caroll de Crebat Mat. junxi coram Gulielmo Shanahan et Brigida Moriarty
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **28** Patritium Hayes et Margaritam Hayes de Honey Pound Mat. junxi coram Michaele Hayes et Brigida Hayes
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **28** Michaelem Enright et Brigidam Donovan de Towreen Mat. junxi, presentibus Brigida Donovan et Johanne Gleeson
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **28** Johannem Walsh de Donoughmore et Mariam Shea una incola in praedio vulgo nominato Caron(?) Mat. junxi coram Edmundo Farrell et Catharina Toomey
— *Lau. Harnett*
* **28** Andream Dillon & Catharinam Ryan Matri. junxit Revd. Jacobus Shea V.P. Coram Thoma Brier & Brigida Ryan.
— *Lau. Harnett*
